method: Independent, evidence-only Cursor CLI synthesis. The model received only this entity's saved evidence package.

sentiment.summary: Coverage over the last 30 days shows generally constructive ecosystem and institutional-product news for Ethereum (including proposed staking features for an Ether ETF and an Ethereum Foundation security-related grant), alongside mixed policy signals such as proposed limits on retail crypto trading access that still explicitly include ether.

tags.label: ether-etf-staking
tags.why: Fidelity moved to add staking and quarterly payouts to its ether ETF, describing reward retention and planned cash distributions.

tags.label: policy-access-limits
tags.why: A reported Russian proposal would restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT and impose an annual purchase limit for non-qualified investors.

tags.label: security-grant
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation announced a Trillion Dollar Security initiative grant to support development of WEBCAT, described as an open source browser verification tool.

tags.label: foundation-governance
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation reported a board update stating that pcaversaccio joined the Ethereum Foundation Board.

sentiment.coverage_note: Usable records with status ok came from Cointelegraph, CoinDesk, and the Ethereum Foundation within a 30-day window; some channels showed key-source failures or gaps (grounding: no-results; reddit: auth-failed; youtube: no-results), so coverage may miss social/video sentiment.
